defect: The viewed-object sidebar hides most settings and cannot show a native session's advertised controls.
why_stupid: This is slop because the original dataclass and session advertisements already declare those settings, while the sidebar replaces discovery with a display-only filter.

slop.fact: which declared settings groups appear in the viewed object's dropdown

edits: Discover visible settings groups through FormBridge and retain the original settings state and declarations.
Let global fields edit and save their original global owner while allowed local overrides keep ObjectState lazy inheritance.
Share the existing session form and model editor with the selected native thread's properties; keep mailbox and file views tied to their own sources.
Run one focused control and inspect the real Textual UI in an isolated st window, then merge and install.
